connector.name: SpriteCook
connector.registryDescription: Generate game assets with AI for 2D games, including sprites, tilesets, and animations.
connector.summary: Hosted at api.spritecook.ai over streamable HTTP. Needs a bearer token header, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published under the domain namespace ai.spritecook. The registry required proof of control over that domain before accepting the record.
connector.authNote: A bearer token is sent in a request header. Store it outside the config file wherever your client supports it.
